eyebrow: Git, GitHub & CI/CD for Data · Chapter 1, Lesson 2
subtitle: Getting Git running on your own machine, on any OS

code:
# Windows (PowerShell)
winget install --id Git.Git -e

# Mac
brew install git

# Linux (Debian/Ubuntu)
sudo apt-get install git-all
caption: One line per OS. Confirm with git --version.

code:
git config --global user.name "Jordan Lee"
git config --global user.email "jordan@example.com"

git config --global --list
caption: --global applies to every repository on your machine, not just one.

code:
cd customer-ltv-project
git init
ls -a

git status
caption: git init creates a hidden .git folder — your .sql files don't change.
